URI::basename
Description
Extracts the basename part of a given uri string.
For the following URI:
/main/index.jsp?user=test&login=check
The basename is:
index.jsp
Syntax
URI
::
basename
<
uri
>
URI::basename <string>
Extracts the basename part of a given uri string.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
set
base
[
URI
::
basename
[
HTTP
::
uri
]]
log
local0.
"Basename of uri [HTTP::uri] is $base"
}
